response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates exceptional technical depth across 17+ years of software development with relevant experience in developer tools and infrastructure, he lacks two critical minimum requirements for this people-leadership role: 2 years of people management experience and 3 years in a documented technical leadership position. His career progression shows strong individual contributor advancement (Staff Engineer level) with informal mentoring through teaching, but no evidence of managing engineers, conducting performance reviews, or leading teams. Without demonstrated people management capability, he cannot effectively execute core responsibilities like 1-on-1s, performance feedback, and team development.
strengths: 17+ years of deep technical expertise across web, mobile, embedded systems, and developer infrastructure with hands-on experience in CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, and build systems

Demonstrated teaching and mentoring ability through multiple workshops (Web Internals, Selenium, TDD), code kata sessions, and open-source projects that show communication skills and knowledge-sharing orientation

Strong background in developer tools creation including testing frameworks (Fluent-Asserts, Trial test runner), GitLab/CI infrastructure setup, MCP code generators, and dev-ops tooling relevant to engineering productivity
concerns: Completely lacks people management experience—all roles are individual contributor positions (Software Developer, Senior Developer, Staff Engineer) with zero evidence of managing teams, conducting 1-on-1s, or setting performance expectations
No technical leadership title or role—career shows individual contributor progression but never as team lead, tech lead, or engineering manager, which is a minimum requirement for this level

Developer tools expertise is broad but not specialized—lacks focused depth in core areas like compilers, large-scale build systems, and enterprise-scale test automation infrastructure central to the role
